## Navimower Map Card 0.3.5-beta11

### Fix editor color defaults and improve status feedback
- Give every native color field the same real default used by the card runtime, so an unset color no longer appears as a misleading black swatch in Home Assistant's visual editor.
- Remove the black-swatch prefix workaround and keep one uniform native label + color-input layout for all color rows.
- Highlight the Schedule button in orange whenever either the native Navimow schedule or the Navimower-managed schedule is enabled.
- Add a red pulsing glow around the mower icon while the lawn_mower entity reports an error state/activity.
- Reuse existing scheduler metadata/entity state; no new polling or heavy browser-side work is added.

Current-cycle rendering, History archives, scheduler editing, commands and map performance are otherwise unchanged.
